## Deprecation notice

`TagSet` is deprecated and will be removed in a future major version.
[`TagOverflow`](?path=/docs/components-tagoverflow--docs) is now the recommended
replacement — it is promoted to a **stable** component in `@carbon/ibm-products`
and will move to `@carbon/react` as part of Carbon v12.

Migrate to [`TagOverflow`](?path=/docs/components-tagoverflow--docs) at your
earliest convenience. The [migration guide below](#migration-guide) covers the
full prop mapping, a before/after example, and an AI-assisted migration prompt.

| Deprecated | Replacement                               |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `TagSet`   | `TagOverflow` from `@carbon/ibm-products` |

### New import

```jsx
// Before
import { TagSet } from '@carbon/ibm-products';

// After
import { TagOverflow } from '@carbon/ibm-products';
```

## Overview

The Tag set component allows users to see all the labels of a cluster in areas
where all tags may not be visible at one time. They provide the ability to see
how many additional labels exist and what they are.

## Example usage

Here it is in use with no overflow. Change max-visible to see an overflow.

</Canvas>

Here it is with more than 10 tags.

<Canvas>
  <Story of={stories.ManyTags} />
</Canvas>

Here it is with hundreds of tags. This option offers a searchable modal to
display all tags.

<Canvas>
  <Story of={stories.HundredsOfTags} />
</Canvas>

Use `allTagsModalCloseLabel` and `allTagsModalSearchClearLabel` to translate the
modal's close and clear-search buttons. If omitted, Carbon's default labels are
used.

## Migration guide

### Prop mapping

| `TagSet` prop          | `TagOverflow` equivalent | Notes                                                            |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tags`                 | `items`                  | Rename the prop                                                  |
| `overflowAutoAlign`    | `autoAlign`              | Rename the prop                                                  |
| `onOverflowClick`      | _(removed)_              | No direct equivalent — see note below                            |
| `containingElementRef` | `containingElementRef`   | Still accepted but deprecated; prefer the forwarded ref          |
| `measurementOffset`    | `measurementOffset`      | Still accepted but deprecated; now auto-calculated               |
| `multiline`            | `multiline`              | Still accepted but deprecated                                    |
| All other props        | Unchanged                | `align`, `maxVisible`, `allTagsModal*`, `showAllTagsLabel`, etc. |

**`onOverflowClick` note:** `TagSet`'s `onOverflowClick` prop (a custom handler
that suppresses the default "show all" modal) has no direct equivalent in
`TagOverflow`. Remove the prop and handle overflow display manually if needed.

### Item object shape

Each entry in the `tags` / `items` array has these field differences:

| `TagSet` item field | `TagOverflow` item field | Notes                                         |
| ------------------- | ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------- |
| `type`              | `tagType`                | Rename every occurrence                       |
| _(none)_            | `id`                     | **Required** — generate from `label` or index |
| `label`             | `label`                  | Unchanged                                     |
| All other fields    | Unchanged                | Pass through unchanged                        |

**Generating `id`:** Each item must have a unique `id`. A reliable strategy is
to derive it from `label` as a kebab-case slug and append the array index to
guarantee uniqueness:

```js
items={tags.map((tag, i) => ({
  ...tag,
  id: tag.label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-') + '-' + i,
  tagType: tag.type,
}))}
```

### Before / after example

```jsx
// Before — TagSet
import { TagSet } from '@carbon/ibm-products';

<TagSet
  tags={[
    { type: 'blue', label: 'Tag 1' },
    { type: 'cyan', label: 'Tag 2' },
    { type: 'red', label: 'Tag 3' },
  ]}
  overflowAutoAlign
  onOverflowClick={(overflowTags) => console.log(overflowTags)}
  maxVisible={2}
  allTagsModalTitle="All tags"
  allTagsModalSearchLabel="Search all tags"
  allTagsModalSearchPlaceholderText="Search all tags"
  showAllTagsLabel="View all tags"
/>;

// After — TagOverflow
import { TagOverflow } from '@carbon/ibm-products';

{
  /*
  TODO: TagSet → TagOverflow migration: onOverflowClick has no direct
  equivalent in TagOverflow. Handle overflow manually or remove this prop.
*/
}
<TagOverflow
  items={[
    { id: 'tag-1-0', tagType: 'blue', label: 'Tag 1' },
    { id: 'tag-2-1', tagType: 'cyan', label: 'Tag 2' },
    { id: 'tag-3-2', tagType: 'red', label: 'Tag 3' },
  ]}
  autoAlign
  maxVisible={2}
  allTagsModalTitle="All tags"
  allTagsModalSearchLabel="Search all tags"
  allTagsModalSearchPlaceholderText="Search all tags"
  showAllTagsLabel="View all tags"
/>;
```

### Codemod

Run the codemod to automate the mechanical parts of the migration:

```sh
npx @carbon/upgrade migrate tagset-to-tagoverflow --write
```

The codemod handles:

- Import specifier rename: `TagSet` → `TagOverflow` (aliased imports like
  `TagSet as Foo` are rewritten to `TagOverflow as Foo`, leaving the alias
  unchanged)
- JSX element rename: `<TagSet>` / `</TagSet>` → `<TagOverflow>` /
  `</TagOverflow>`
- Prop renames: `tags` → `items`, `overflowAutoAlign` → `autoAlign`
- Per-item field transforms on **static inline arrays**: `type` → `tagType`,
  injects an `id` derived from `label` as a lowercase slug (skipped when an `id`
  already exists)
- Removes `onOverflowClick` and inserts a `// TODO` comment in its place
- Annotates deprecated props (`containingElementRef`, `measurementOffset`,
  `multiline`) with an inline `// @deprecated` comment

It **cannot** handle automatically (leaves `// TODO` comments):

- `onOverflowClick` → no direct equivalent; remove the prop and handle overflow
  display manually if needed
- **Dynamic `tags` reference** (e.g. `tags={myTags}`) → renames the prop to
  `items` but cannot transform the variable; a `// TODO` comment is added to
  remind you to rename `type` → `tagType` and add `id` to each item manually

### AI-assisted migration

Copy the prompt below into Bob or any AI assistant, then paste your component
source after the final line.

```
You are migrating a React component from the deprecated @carbon/ibm-products
TagSet API to the TagOverflow API.

IMPORT CHANGES:
- TagSet → TagOverflow (same package: @carbon/ibm-products)

PROP RENAME TABLE (TagSet prop → TagOverflow equivalent):
- tags                → items
- overflowAutoAlign   → autoAlign
- onOverflowClick     → REMOVE — no direct equivalent (see note below)
- containingElementRef → containingElementRef (deprecated; prefer forwarded ref)
- measurementOffset   → measurementOffset (deprecated; now auto-calculated)
- multiline           → multiline (deprecated)

ITEM OBJECT SHAPE (each entry in the tags / items array):
| TagSet item field | TagOverflow item field | Notes                                       |
|-------------------|------------------------|---------------------------------------------|
| type              | tagType                | Rename every occurrence                     |
| (none)            | id                     | Required — generate from label slug + index |
| label             | label                  | Unchanged                                   |
| All other fields  |                        | Pass through unchanged                      |

GENERATING THE REQUIRED `id` FIELD:
Each item must have a unique `id`. Recommended strategy — derive from `label`
as a kebab-case slug, then append the array index to guarantee uniqueness:
  id: label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-') + '-' + index

`onOverflowClick` NOTE:
TagSet's `onOverflowClick` prop has no direct equivalent in TagOverflow.
Insert a TODO comment where it appeared:
  // TODO: TagSet → TagOverflow migration: onOverflowClick has no direct
  // equivalent in TagOverflow. Handle overflow manually or remove this prop.

DEPRECATED-BUT-PRESENT PROPS:
Leave `containingElementRef`, `measurementOffset`, and `multiline` in place
if they exist and add an inline `// @deprecated` comment so teams can clean up
at their own pace.

BEFORE / AFTER EXAMPLE:

// Before (TagSet)
import { TagSet } from '@carbon/ibm-products';

<TagSet
  tags={[
    { type: 'blue', label: 'Tag 1' },
    { type: 'cyan', label: 'Tag 2' },
    { type: 'red',  label: 'Tag 3' },
  ]}
  overflowAutoAlign
  onOverflowClick={(overflowTags) => console.log(overflowTags)}
  maxVisible={2}
  allTagsModalTitle="All tags"
  allTagsModalSearchLabel="Search all tags"
  allTagsModalSearchPlaceholderText="Search all tags"
  showAllTagsLabel="View all tags"
/>

// After (TagOverflow)
import { TagOverflow } from '@carbon/ibm-products';

{/*
  TODO: TagSet → TagOverflow migration: onOverflowClick has no direct
  equivalent in TagOverflow. Handle overflow manually or remove this prop.
*/}
<TagOverflow
  items={[
    { id: 'tag-1-0', tagType: 'blue', label: 'Tag 1' },
    { id: 'tag-2-1', tagType: 'cyan', label: 'Tag 2' },
    { id: 'tag-3-2', tagType: 'red',  label: 'Tag 3' },
  ]}
  autoAlign
  maxVisible={2}
  allTagsModalTitle="All tags"
  allTagsModalSearchLabel="Search all tags"
  allTagsModalSearchPlaceholderText="Search all tags"
  showAllTagsLabel="View all tags"
/>

Now migrate the following component:
```
